info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Get debug configuration for a job component

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

items.docs: Retrieves the debug configuration for a specific component of a Dataflow job in the given project and regional location. Used internally by Dataflow workers for debugging purposes.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Send debug capture data for a job component

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

items.docs: Submits encoded debug information for a specific component of a Dataflow job in the given project and regional location. Used internally by Dataflow workers for submitting debug data.
